notes: ONE-TIME EXPENSES: PLANNED vs ACTUAL, with journal linking. Also fixes a double-count that was inflating past and current months. THE BUG: expandSingleOneOff placed a planned one-off in its month and every twelve months after when 'repeat annually' was set, with nothing restricting that to future months. The inputs editor drops non-repeating past entries on save but keeps repeating ones, so an annual item such as a Diwali trip sat in every October including the current one — and any journal one-time expense that month was ADDED ON TOP. A code comment asserted 'Edit-inputs is future-only and Journal is past/current-only, so no overlap'; that held for one-shot items only. Reproduced: a Rs 80,000 planned trip with Rs 45,000 and Rs 5,000 logged against it showed Rs 1,30,000 in the One-time row and Rs 1,90,000 in Total Expenses. Correct figures are Rs 50,000 of Rs 80,000 and Rs 1,10,000. The Rs 80,000 overstatement flowed straight into surplus and the cash chain. WHAT IS NEW: (1) Planned one-offs carry stable ids (schema v17, applied to both income and expense). The ids survive the inputs editor, which rebuilds the whole array from the DOM on save — without that, every link would break silently the next time inputs were touched. (2) The journal's one-time expense entry gains a 'Counts towards' picker, listing only plans that fall in the month of the chosen date, each showing what is already claimed against it and what remains. Linking a November payment to an October budget is therefore impossible. (3) A linked payment CONSUMES its plan instead of adding to it. (4) The projection row now follows the same convention as every other row: past shows actual, current shows actual-of-planned via fmtDual, future shows the plan. (5) The hover breakdown keeps its per-item split and gains the same treatment — a tracked item reads 'Rs 45,000 of Rs 80,000', turning red when overspent; unplanned spending is labelled as such; a future month lists plans only. PER-OCCURRENCE LINKING: a repeating item is a separate budget each year, grown by the expense growth rate, so Diwali 2027 (Rs 84,800) is independent of Diwali 2026 (Rs 80,000) and payments against one never touch the other. Verified. UNPLANNED MONTHS ARE UNCHANGED: the Budget page's One-time row still carries a hard-coded budget of zero, so any spend in a month with nothing planned reads as over and goes full red. ORPHANED LINKS: if a plan is deleted, transactions pointing at it fall back to unplanned rather than disappearing, so logged money is never lost from the sheet. VERIFIED: occurrence resolution (Oct 2026 Rs 80,000 / Rs 14,000; Oct 2027 Rs 84,800 / Rs 14,840; Nov 2026 none); partial claims (Rs 45,000 + Rs 20,000 against Rs 80,000, Rs 5,000 unplanned); per-year isolation; overspend detection (Rs 95,000 against Rs 80,000 flags over); orphan fallback; picker visibility only for one-time expenses and only with a date set; existing links preselected when editing a transaction. Dashboard, Budget, Budget-actuals, Instruments, Rates and Decisions all re-run clean with no page errors. UNCHANGED: the projection engine, runProjection, the v2026.05.05.15 live-anchored EOM savings fix, and the Decisions tab shipped in v2026.05.06.x.
